mapper.select: SELECT id, place_group_id AS placeGroupId, image_url AS imageUrl, original_name AS originalName, map_width AS mapWidth, map_height AS mapHeight, uploaded_by AS uploadedBy, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM place_group_maps WHERE place_group_id = #{placeGroupId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO place_group_maps (place_group_id, image_url, original_name, map_width, map_height, uploaded_by) VALUES (#{placeGroupId}, #{imageUrl}, #{originalName}, #{mapWidth}, #{mapHeight}, #{uploadedBy}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE image_url = VALUES(image_url), original_name = VALUES(original_name), map_width = VALUES(map_width), map_height = VALUES(map_height), uploaded_by = VALUES(uploaded_by), updated_at = NOW()
